note: v2: BURIED-override items. The salient general rule is stated and elaborated first; the answer-determining override is buried later, tersely, often without a 'however' flag. This is what induces the present-but-skimmed (PS) omission failure in bare mode. AB = uncovered-category question (correct=abstain). accept/trap are normalized match lists; numbers matched as exact tokens.

items.passage: Acme Corp offers a generous and competitive paid-leave policy that staff consistently rate highly. The standard annual allotment is 20 days, accrued monthly, and unused days may be carried over up to a limit of five into the next year. Employees are encouraged to take their full leave for wellbeing. Part-time staff hired after January 2020 accrue at a reduced rate of 12 days per year. Jordan joined Acme as a part-time employee in March 2022.
items.question: How many days of annual paid leave does Jordan accrue?

items.passage: Our online store is proud to offer free standard shipping on every order over $50, a perk customers love. Orders are processed within one business day and most arrive within a week, with tracking provided. Shipping costs, when they apply, are computed from the order subtotal at checkout. Large furniture pieces carry a flat $40 handling charge that the free-shipping threshold does not waive. A shopper's cart contains a single sofa priced at $600.
items.question: What shipping or handling charge applies to this order at checkout?

items.passage: The city library charges overdue fines to encourage timely returns and keep popular titles in circulation. The fine accrues at $0.25 for each day an item is late and is billed to the borrower's account, up to a maximum of $10 per item. Fines may be settled online or at the front desk. Borrowers younger than eighteen are exempt from all overdue fines. A twelve-year-old borrower returns a book ten days late.
items.question: What overdue fine is charged to this borrower?

items.passage: Every product we sell is backed by our standard manufacturer warranty of one full year from the date of purchase, covering defects in materials and workmanship under normal use. Claims can be filed online with a receipt. Units sold as refurbished instead carry a reduced warranty term of 90 days. The customer purchased a refurbished unit last week.
items.question: What is the warranty period for this customer's purchase?

items.passage: Loyalty members enjoy a 10% discount on most purchases as our thank-you for their continued business, applied automatically at checkout to eligible items. The program is free to join and points also accrue. Items marked clearance are sold at their listed price and receive no further discount. A loyalty member is buying an item marked clearance.
items.question: What discount is applied to this member's clearance item?

items.passage: The downtown garage charges $5 per hour for parking, with a generous daily maximum of $30 so commuters are never overcharged. Payment is by card or the city app, and spaces are plentiful. Electric vehicles receive the first two hours free under the city's green initiative. An electric vehicle is parked for exactly two hours.
items.question: What is the parking charge for this vehicle?

items.passage: Accounts that fall past due are assessed a late fee of $30, which appears on the following statement and helps offset administrative costs. Customers can avoid it by enabling autopay. A borrower's very first late payment is automatically waived as a courtesy. This is the borrower's first-ever late payment.
items.question: What late fee is assessed to this borrower?

items.passage: Under the visitor program, travelers may remain in the country for up to 90 days per entry, a limit designed to cover typical tourism and short business trips; extensions require a separate application. Citizens of Andoria, by longstanding treaty, may instead remain for up to 180 days. The applicant holds Andorian citizenship.
items.question: What is the maximum permitted stay for this applicant?

items.passage: A sales tax of 8% is applied to retail purchases at the register and remitted to the state each month; receipts itemize the tax for the customer's records. The rate has been stable for years. Unprepared grocery items are exempt from this sales tax. The purchase consists entirely of unprepared groceries.
items.question: What sales tax applies to this purchase?

items.passage: The posted speed limit on this stretch of highway is 65 mph for general traffic and is enforced by automated cameras with mailed citations. The road is well maintained and frequently patrolled. Commercial trucks are restricted to a lower limit of 55 mph on the same stretch. The vehicle in question is a commercial truck.
items.question: What speed limit applies to this vehicle?

items.passage: Customers may return most items within 30 days of purchase for a full refund, provided the item is in original condition with tags attached; refunds go to the original payment method. The policy is among the most flexible in the industry. Items sold as final sale are not eligible for return or refund. The item was purchased on final sale.
items.question: Within how many days, if at all, may this item be returned?
